app_fee.value: USD 120 for international applicants on a nonimmigrant visa studying in the U.S. (e.g. F-1); the fee is non-refundable.
app_fee.quote: $120: International students on any nonimmigrant visa type studying in the U.S. (e.g., F-1, H1-B, H-4, etc).

fee_waiver.value: ASU Admission Services offers no general fee waiver; some academic units grant their own waivers, so ask your department.
fee_waiver.quote: Admission Services does not offer a general application fee waiver. However, you are welcome to check with your program of interest’s academic unit to see if waivers are an option.

gre_general.value: Set by each program; ASU does not accept the at-home GRE General Test.

also.quote: Please note that ASU does not accept the GRE® General Test at home.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 80 for tests taken before January 21, 2026, or 4 on the new scale for tests on or after that date; some programs set higher minimums.
toefl_min.quote: For exams taken before January 21, 2026: Minimum score of 80.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall (Duolingo 105 and PTE also accepted).
ielts_min.quote: Overall band score on the academic test of at least 6.5.

also.quote: Duolingo English test | Graduate minimum score of 105.

english_waiver.value: India is not on ASU's list of English-speaking countries, but a bachelor's or higher from an institution where English was the only language of instruction can be exempted through the Medium of Instruction form with an official letter or the institution's website.
english_waiver.quote: Degree from an International Institution Where English is the Sole Medium of Instruction | Earned a bachelor’s degree or higher from an international institution where English was the only language of instruction. | A letter on official letterhead from the institution confirming English as the sole language of instruction OR a link to the institution’s official website verifying the language of instruction

notes: Minimum GPA 3.00 generally applies. TOEFL new-scale minimum 4 for exams on or after January 21, 2026. Programs may set higher English requirements.
